work.author: f GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act grants indulgences to members of Magdalena of Canossa's Sons of Charity house and oratory in Venice. Issuer evidence f GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF8307; own dating clause LF8415–8418 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem sub annulo piscatoris die secunda septem- bris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF8360 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
